products.name: NitroGROW
products.tagline: Nitrogen-fixing bio-fertilizer for stronger, greener, high-yield crops.
products.description: NitroGROW is a scientifically developed nitrogen-fixing bio-fertilizer that boosts natural nitrogen availability in the soil. It strengthens root development, improves leaf colour and vigour, and helps farmers reduce dependency on chemical urea while improving long-term soil health.
products.best: Cereals, vegetables, and all field crops
benefits: Fixes atmospheric nitrogen naturally in the root zone
Improves plant vigour, leaf colour, and crop yield
Reduces dependency on chemical nitrogen fertilizers
Safe, eco-friendly, and suitable for all crops
usage: Mix as per label dosage with water or soil application
Apply during early crop stages for best results
Use under GreenRoot technical or field team guidance
Store in a cool, dry, shaded place away from sunlight

products.name: P-SOUL
products.tagline: Phosphate-mobilising bio-fertilizer for powerful root growth.
products.description: P-SOUL is a phosphate-solubilising bio-fertilizer that unlocks fixed phosphorus in the soil and makes it available to plants. It promotes strong root systems, better flowering and fruiting, and improves overall nutrient uptake for healthier, more productive crops.
benefits: Solubilises fixed phosphorus for easy plant uptake
Encourages strong, healthy root development
Improves flowering, fruiting, and grain filling
Enhances the efficiency of applied fertilizers
usage: Apply as per recommended dosage on the label
Best used during root and flowering stages
Can be combined with GreenRoot bio-inputs on expert advice
Store in a cool, dry, shaded place

products.name: TrichoShield
products.tagline: Trichoderma-based bio-fungicide that protects crops from soil-borne disease.
products.description: TrichoShield is a Trichoderma-based bio-fungicide that protects crops against harmful soil-borne fungal diseases such as root rot, wilt, and damping-off. It colonises the root zone, suppresses pathogens naturally, and supports healthy, disease-free plant growth without chemical residue.
benefits: Protects against root rot, wilt, and damping-off
Colonises roots and suppresses harmful fungi naturally
Improves plant health and survival rate
Residue-free and safe for beneficial soil organisms
usage: Apply through soil treatment, seed treatment, or drenching
Use as per crop-wise dosage on the label
Avoid mixing with chemical fungicides
Store in a cool, dry, shaded place

products.name: Verticillium Bio-Insecticide
products.tagline: Biological insect control that keeps crops protected the natural way.
products.description: This Verticillium-based bio-insecticide offers effective biological control of sucking pests such as whitefly, aphids, and mealybugs. It works naturally to reduce pest pressure, protects beneficial insects, and helps farmers cut down on harmful chemical pesticide use.
benefits: Controls whitefly, aphids, mealybugs, and thrips
Works biologically without harming beneficial insects
Reduces chemical pesticide dependency
Supports safe and sustainable crop protection
usage: Spray as per label dosage during early pest stages
Apply in evening hours for best effectiveness
Repeat as recommended by GreenRoot field team
Store away from direct sunlight and heat

products.name: GrowMix
products.tagline: Balanced soil enrichment mix for fertile, living, productive soil.
products.description: GrowMix is a balanced soil enrichment blend that restores organic matter and beneficial microbial life to tired soils. It improves soil structure, water-holding capacity, and nutrient availability, giving crops a strong, fertile foundation for healthy growth.
benefits: Restores organic matter and microbial activity
Improves soil structure and water retention
Enhances nutrient availability to plant roots
Builds long-term soil fertility naturally
usage: Apply during land preparation or basal dose
Mix well into the root-zone soil
Use with GreenRoot crop nutrition guidance
Store in a cool, dry, shaded place
